lines.t: Everything which comes from the mouth
A song for all those who have ears to hear
A vision to all who have eyes to see my splendor
Painted by the word of my glory
And an overflowing fountain inside those
Whose hearts are open to me
Man shall not live by bread alone
That proceeds from the mouth of God
But man shall not live by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds from the mouth of God.
That proceeds from the mouth of God
Man shall not live by bread alone
But by every word that proceeds from the mouth of God
